summary: Count loop-round activity when deciding whether a parent run has stalled

replay.detail: No projection replay or history rewrite. The evaluator reads existing linked round runs when it evaluates a parent that reports stalls.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or claim fields change. Child runs use the existing parent-step index.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and claim registry are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Parent stall reports include activity from child runs linked to its steps, including loop rounds and nested work. Active child work postpones the parent stall deadline; silence after that activity still reports once. Failure, cancellation and completion reports retain their behavior. No client or wire fields change.

downtime.detail: No migration or restart-specific work is needed.

manual.detail: Existing report-to missions use this corrected activity scope automatically.

recovery.detail: Returning to the previous binary restores parent-only stall timing. Existing report messages remain in the graph.
